notes: Concise primary-source findings. Published dates are retained where confirmed. Checked-only pages are not presented as newly published reports. These do not replace the October 6 statistical snapshot.

players.name: Ryan Sloan
players.finding: Seattle reported added two-seam and cutter looks, with late-count secondary command still a development goal.

players.name: Liam Doyle
players.finding: MLB described his initial Double-A assignment as aggressive; early struggles are context, not a current-season verdict.

players.name: Jamie Arnold
players.finding: Facial fractures interrupted his Triple-A arrival; no return timetable was announced.

players.name: Carlos Lagrange
players.finding: New York announced a Triple-A relief move while retaining a longer-term starting goal.

players.name: Jack Wenninger
players.finding: MLB’s June Statcast review continued to identify the splitter as his best pitch.

players.name: Andrew Fischer
players.finding: MLB named him its Hitting Prospect of the Year after a 162 wRC+ season.

players.name: Luke Adams
players.finding: A three-homer Triple-A game supplied a power highlight, not proof of sustained MLB-ready impact.

players.name: Jesus Made
players.finding: An official highlight recorded a 99.9-mph throw; arm strength and routine accuracy remain different questions.

players.name: Leo De Vries
players.finding: Midland confirmed right-shoulder labrum surgery and an expected eight-month recovery.

players.name: Caleb Bonemer
players.finding: Chicago announced center-field work alongside his infield development, including continued defensive work in the Fall League.

players.name: Charlie Condon
players.finding: Two grand slams highlighted his Triple-A power; that game does not settle his breaking-ball recognition.

players.name: Franklin Arias
players.finding: MLB documented a substantial 2026 power step forward after his earlier glove-first reputation.

players.name: Theo Gillen
players.finding: His Double-A promotion followed a .342/.449/.589 High-A line in 57 games.

players.name: Nelson Rada
players.finding: The Angels reassigned him despite encouraging spring on-base ability and center-field defense.

players.name: Max Anderson
players.finding: Spring game coverage documented work at both second and third base.

players.name: James Tibbs III
players.finding: MLB highlighted a Triple-A season reaching 100 runs, walks and RBIs.

players.name: Enrique Bradfield Jr.
players.finding: The earlier proximity report noted hamstring injuries in both legs during 2025; this is historical health context.

players.name: Blake Burke
players.finding: MLB’s scouting profile describes a first-base-only defensive fit and below-average speed.

players.name: Alfredo Duno
players.finding: Stephenson is approaching free agency; Duno is not expected ready for Opening Day 2027 after limited Double-A exposure.

players.name: Mike Sirota
players.finding: Official transactions show an August injured-list activation and a September 18 Triple-A assignment.

players.name: Eli Willits
players.finding: MLB documented his first Double-A homer and a four-hit game at age 18.

players.name: Aidan Miller
players.finding: September reporting announced his return to games after the recurring back problem and June procedure.

players.name: Jarlin Susana
players.finding: MLB described a mid-August return after lat surgery, with short outings and Fall League innings rebuilding workload.

players.name: Jaxon Wiggins
players.finding: The Cubs identified health and command as the remaining hurdles after his upper-level success.

players.name: Kemp Alderman
players.finding: MLB’s tool grades favor power over hitting and fielding, reinforcing the need for a bat-led route.

players.name: Brandon Clarke
players.finding: MLB documented a slow 2026 buildup after prior blister problems; the Double-A arrival is a small-sample milestone.
